headline: 世足中場秀評價兩極
context: 2026世界盃決賽首度加入NFL超級盃式的中場秀，請來夏奇拉（Shakira）、瑪丹娜（Madonna）與Coldplay站台，但球迷對這種「球賽變演唱會」的安排評價兩極。這屆賽事也留下不少花絮，從主播出包片段到一隻走失的貓，網路話題不斷。

sources.name: The Guardian
sources.summary: It zipped along, cramming in Shakira, Madonna and Coldplay, but football fans may not be convinced of need for this mid-match spectacle Like hydration breaks and Donald Trump’s ability to get refereeing decisions overturned by simply phoning up the president of Fifa and complaining, the final half-time show is an innovation of the 2026 World Cup that comes with a degree of controversy attached. For one thing, its existence automatically means the World Cup final breaks the International Football Association’s 15-minute half-time mandate. For another, its obvious antecedent lies in the NFL’s Super Bowl, where the half-time entertainment has mushroomed over the decades from a few marching bands to one of the big pop events of the year. To its detractors, it smacks of America not so much embracing the World Cup as imposing itself upon it. Continue reading...
sources.title: Hits, misses and Muppets: the star-studded World Cup half-time show nobody asked for

sources.name: The Guardian
sources.summary: A pranked England manager, a bored Beckham, a Viking takeover and an unwise Wayne Rooney wager: here are the TV treasures of the beautiful game’s biggest ever tournament A stodgy final saw silky Spain deservedly beat cynical Argentina. Football wasn’t coming home after all as England suffered semi-final heartbreak again, before salvaging some pride to finish third – their best World Cup finish since 1966. The Tartan Army drank America’s bars dry as their team went out with a whimper. Cape Verde lasted longer than Germany. It was the end of the road for Ronaldo and Modric, while the phrase “hydration break” entered everyday parlance. But beyond the pitch, it has been an eventful five weeks, too. Here are 26 viral World Cup moments you might have missed … Continue reading...
sources.title: From Gary Lineker’s revenge to the bizarre tale of a missing cat: the best viral TV moments of the World Cup

thread_text:
🧵 1/N
📌 八大藝術

世足中場秀評價兩極

2026世界盃決賽第一次比照美式足球超級盃的規格，安排了盛大中場秀，請來夏奇拉（Shakira）、瑪丹娜（Madonna）與Coldplay輪番上陣。問題是，這場秀讓比賽打破了國際足協原本15分鐘中場休息的規定，也讓球迷質疑，世界盃是不是正在被美式娛樂邏輯接管。

除了中場秀，這屆賽事五週下來也留下不少讓人會心一笑的花絮——從主播出包片段，到一隻走失貓咪的離奇故事，都成了網路熱門話題。

—— 本則整理自 The Guardian，2026 年 7 月 20 日發佈，讓圖書館員翻譯給你聽。

voice_text: 這屆世界盃決賽，第一次搬出超級盃等級的中場秀。夏奇拉、瑪丹娜、Coldplay輪番上陣，場面確實盛大。但問題也跟著來——這場秀讓比賽打破了國際足協原本15分鐘中場休息的規定，不少球迷質疑，世界盃是不是正在被美式娛樂那一套接管。除了中場秀，這五週賽事也留下不少讓人會心一笑的花絮，從主播出包片段，到一隻走失貓咪的離奇故事，都在網路上被瘋傳。
